# annotated multi-catch alternative

try {
  risky();
} catch (IOException | @TypeUse SQLException exception) {}

==>

Program(
  TryStatement(
    try,
    Block(
      ExpressionStatement(
        MethodInvocation(MethodName(Identifier), ArgumentList))),
    CatchClause(
      catch,
      CatchFormalParameter(
        CatchType(
          TypeName,
          MarkerAnnotation(Identifier),
          TypeName),
        Definition),
      Block)))
